entries.text:
1	# Architecture (from the agreed sketch)
2	
3	> No separate architecture step: the work is M with low risk, and the owner agreed on sketch v1. Build what the sketch shows, properly.
4	
5	## Stack
6	- TypeScript 7.0
7	- Vite 8.3
8	- Preact 11.2
9	- idb 8.0 (installed, not used yet)
10	
11	## How to run
12	cd web && npm install && npm run dev, then open http://localhost:5173 (add ?d=grid or ?d=cards for the other directions)
13	
14	## Verify commands (as the sketch found them)
15	- `cd web && npm run build`
16	
17	## What the sketch showed
18	Three takes on the one screen of the habit tracker, each with the same real content: today's habits, one-tap ticking, current and longest streaks, and a 6-month heatmap. Ticking works and updates streaks instantly. The habits and their history are generated in memory, so a reload resets them; saving to IndexedDB and export/import are not built yet.
19	
20	### Real in the sketch
21	- Preact + Vite app, really running; layout, components and colours are the app's
22	- Streak maths (current and longest) and the 6-month heatmap are computed from the tick data, using local-date keys so months, leap years and time zones cannot shift a day
23	- Tickin… (837 more)
Now let me check db.ts exports and types.ts to use correct function signatures.
